description: This file defines the RatingViewModel class responsible for managing UI state and interactions related to media rating functionality within an Android application. It includes state management, countdown timer logic, and methods for preparing the view, handling user actions, and submitting ratings.

classes.name: RatingUiState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state for the rating overlay, including visibility, message, countdown seconds, focus, and missing keys.

classes.name: RatingViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class managing the rating feature, handling preparation, countdown, user actions, and submissions.

methods.name: prepareFor
methods.description: Prepares the UI for a specific media item identified by groupId, fetching data, setting initial state, and starting countdown.

methods.name: startCountdown
methods.description: Initiates a countdown timer that updates the remainingSeconds in the UI state and hides the overlay when complete.

methods.name: onActionSelected
methods.description: Handles user actions (LIKE, LOVE, DISLIKE, CLOSE), updating the UI state and submitting data accordingly.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a rating for a media item through the ratings repository and updates UI state post-submission.
